feed.title: Testing & QA — Useful Sites
feed.subtitle: A hand-curated, annotated link directory across ten areas, from software and AI to security, economics and architecture. Every entry states what the resource does and where it parts ways with its neighbours.

entry.title: Academy Bugs
entry.summary: A practice site with 25 real bugs planted inside for you to find.

entry.title: Airport Gap
entry.summary: A RESTful API built to improve your API automation testing.

entry.title: API Challenges
entry.summary: A series of challenges, tutorials and references for practising API testing.

entry.title: Applitools
entry.summary: A visual regression testing platform that compares screens with visual AI.

entry.title: Applitools Demo
entry.summary: A demo designed for visual testing, comparable against a second version. Unlike functional testing it targets catching changes in how the screen looks.

entry.title: AutomateNow Practice
entry.summary: A clean automation practice page for trying different interaction types.

entry.title: Automation Exercise
entry.summary: An automation practice site with a UI and API backend, including test-case examples.

entry.title: Awesome Appium
entry.summary: A resource list for Appium, the mobile-app test-automation tool.

entry.title: Awesome AVA
entry.summary: A list of plugins and resources for AVA, the JavaScript test runner.

entry.title: Awesome CodeRabbit
entry.summary: A resource list for CodeRabbit, the AI-powered code-review platform.

entry.title: Awesome Gatling
entry.summary: A resource list for Gatling, the Scala-based load- and performance-testing framework.

entry.title: Awesome JMeter
entry.summary: A resource list for JMeter, the load- and performance-testing tool.

entry.title: Awesome k6
entry.summary: A resource list for k6, the developer-centric load and performance testing tool. Unlike general performance lists it focuses on one tool and its scripting ecosystem.

entry.title: Awesome Playwright
entry.summary: A list of tools, plugins and examples for the Playwright ecosystem. Unlike the official docs it brings together community tooling and real project examples.

entry.title: Awesome Regression Testing
entry.summary: A list of visual-regression tools that verify changes did not break functionality or style.

entry.title: Awesome Selenium
entry.summary: A collection of the Selenium browser-automation framework and its surrounding tools. Unlike scattered search it gathers language bindings, grid and plugins in one place.

entry.title: Awesome Test Automation
entry.summary: A list gathering test-automation frameworks, tools and resources by language and platform. Unlike scattered searches it collects them all in one organised place.

entry.title: Awesome Testing
entry.summary: A list gathering every branch of software testing — unit, end-to-end, performance, contract — with resources. You can also find the rest of this field’s practice sites here.

entry.title: Beeceptor
entry.summary: Spins up a mock REST endpoint in seconds and intercepts or fakes HTTP requests.

entry.title: BlazeDemo
entry.summary: BlazeMeter’s simple travel-agency demo for performance testing.

entry.title: Browserling
entry.summary: Live-test your site across different browsers and operating systems.

entry.title: CandyMapper
entry.summary: A web app with traps, built to practise test-automation skills.

entry.title: Coffee Cart
entry.summary: A simple app for practising basic interactions through ordering coffee. Unlike large demos it is small enough to grasp in five minutes yet full enough for cart/logic testing.

entry.title: Commit Quality
entry.summary: A practice site with high-quality Playwright automation examples.

entry.title: Countries GraphQL API
entry.summary: A simple GraphQL API to interact with country data.

entry.title: Cypress
entry.summary: An end-to-end testing framework that runs in the browser with live reload and time-travel debugging.

entry.title: DemoBlaze
entry.summary: A sample shop designed to automate against, with a walk-through.

entry.title: DemoQA
entry.summary: A broad automation practice set with forms, widgets, interactions and a bookstore app. Unlike single-page sites it has enough variety to exercise a whole framework end to end.

entry.title: DummyJSON
entry.summary: A fake JSON REST API offering dozens of resources for quick prototyping and test data.

entry.title: Evil Tester Test Pages
entry.summary: A collection of pages for testing different components and functionality one by one.

entry.title: Expand Testing
entry.summary: An automation practice app usable for both UI and API testing.

entry.title: Fake Store API
entry.summary: A fake e-commerce REST API with products, carts and users for front-end prototypes.

entry.title: GoREST
entry.summary: A test API with OAuth2 authentication and write support, over REST and GraphQL. Unlike read-only fake APIs it truly lets you exercise create/update flows.

entry.title: Hands-On Selenium WebDriver
entry.summary: A practice page bundling a wide variety of web elements to interact with via Selenium.

entry.title: httpbin
entry.summary: An HTTP request-and-response testing service that echoes headers, body and response — handy for exercising a client.

entry.title: httpstat.us
entry.summary: A tiny service that returns any HTTP status code (and delay) you ask for, to test error paths.

entry.title: Insomnia
entry.summary: A clean API client for REST, GraphQL and gRPC requests. Unlike Postman it is lighter and open source, and can be versioned with git.

entry.title: JSONPlaceholder
entry.summary: A zero-setup test API that returns realistic fake JSON on request. Unlike running your own mock it is instantly available — the standard for prototypes and tutorials.

entry.title: Katalon
entry.summary: A low-code test automation tool for web, API and mobile that builds scenarios without coding.

entry.title: LetCode
entry.summary: A site with many element examples for end-to-end automation practice.
